Hi Ben,

Attaching our procurement checklist and a draft PO for the Redwood Order Form. Two things came up in our review that we need clarified before we can route this to Finance for signature: 

1) VAT / withholding — our tax team indicates in our jurisdiction we may be required to withhold tax on cross-border services (withholding tax). Will Redwood accept invoices net of withholding provided we supply the official withholding certificate?

2) Net terms — our standard is Net45 for new vendors. The order form shows Net30. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept Net45, or if there is a payment schedule/discount we should consider?

Also please confirm billing contact and PO routing details (email and PO reference format).

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Order form questions — VAT withholding and net terms

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear notes and the draft PO. Looping in Kimberly (finance) and Marissa (legal) to weigh in on the tax + net terms items.

High level: we can be flexible on net terms for first year while we establish billing cadence; we typically require invoices at time of billing to include a gross amount and a tax line item so our finance team can reconcile (see attached invoice sample). On withholding: Redwood's standard is that the customer pays applicable taxes; if withholding is required by the customers jurisdiction we can accept net-of-withholding provided we receive the official certificate/receipt and the Order Form includes the agreed language. Marissa will propose specific redline language for the Order Form / MSA.

Next steps:
- Marissa: legal redline for "Taxes and Withholding" + guidance on proof required.
- Kimberly: confirm whether Net45 for year 1 is acceptable and whether we should add a small late-fee clause.
- Liam / Acme: please confirm billing contact + the PO numbering scheme you will use.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Order form questions — VAT withholding and net terms

Quick notes from finance: 

- VAT / Sales tax: Invoices should show gross amount + tax line so we can map to tax reporting. If customer will withhold, we need the withholding certificate (local tax authority form) within 30 days of payment to apply credit.
- Net terms: Standard is Net30. For new logos we can accept Net45 for the first 12 months as a one-time concession, provided there is an explicit note in the Order Form and we reserve the right to revert to Net30 after the period.
- Late fee: suggest 1.5% per month after due date (commercially typical) — ok to include if we can keep the concession.
- PO routing: prefer PO number in subject and body of invoice and send invoices to billing@redwood.com (cc finance@redwood.com). If Acme requires an alternate billing email per region, we can accommodate with prior notice.

I'll leave exact language to Marissa but flagged the finance constraints.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Liam Turner <liam.turner@acmelabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Order form questions — VAT withholding and net terms (redline proposals)

Ben / Kim — drafting proposed redlines for the Order Form and a short MSA amendment. Key points below (I attached the redline doc):

1) Taxes and Withholding (Order Form / MSA clause)
- Proposed language: "Except as required by applicable law, Customer shall be responsible for all taxes, duties and other governmental assessments (except Redwoods income taxes). If Customer is required by applicable law to withhold or deduct any amount from payments due to Redwood, Customer shall: (a) notify Redwood in writing and (b) provide Redwood with official documentation evidencing the tax withheld. Redwood will apply a credit for the documented withholding against amounts due. Customer shall provide any required certificates of residence or withholding tax receipts within thirty (30) days of payment."

2) Invoice content and routing
- Invoice must include PO number and billing contact; invoices should show the gross service amount, tax amount separately, and the net payable after withholding if applicable.

3) Temporary net-terms concession
- Add a one-time Order Form addendum: "Net45 for first twelve (12) months from Effective Date; thereafter invoices revert to Net30 unless otherwise agreed in writing."

4) Proof & indemnity
- If Customer withholds, include a sentence that proper evidence releases Customer from further liability for the withheld portion. If Customer fails to provide evidence within 30 days, Redwood may seek recovery for the withheld amount.

I kept the language intentionally standard and limited in scope to avoid creating ongoing audit burden. Please let me know if you want escrow/holdback language instead of crediting.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_amendment.docx (document, stub)

Hi Liam / Olivia — thanks for raising these early. Summary and ask: 

- Redwood can accept Net45 for the first 12 months (one-time concession). After twelve months invoices revert to Net30 unless otherwise amended.
- Regarding withholding: we will accept payment net of withholding provided Acme supplies official withholding certificates / proof within 30 days; Redwood will credit the documented withholding against amounts due. Marissa attached proposed redline text for your review.
- Invoices should include PO number in the invoice body and be sent to billing@redwood.com (cc finance@redwood.com).

Can you confirm: (1) billing contact name/email for where we should send invoices, and (2) whether Acme can provide a government-issued withholding certificate after payment (you indicated yes on the call)? Once confirmed we can finalize the Order Form redline and sign.

If acceptable, please return a signed PO referencing "Redwood Order Form v1.1" and the PO number (we'll use that as the invoice reference).

Best,
